title: Coast Guard rescues four workers from collapsed water tower
credit: US Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Astoria
description: Coast Guard aircrews from Air Station Astoria hoist four men, one-by-one, from a large, empty water tower, May 13, 2025, Taholah, Washington. The 4 men had fallen more than 60 feet and we unable to walk. (US Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Astoria)
